backend/main.mo: Exposes a single method returning the caller's principal.
feature_evidence.json: Catalogs feature evidence entries, listing affected files, components, and test IDs for two documented features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions of numerous frontend files, summarizing their roles in the quiz app.
frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md: Explains configuring and deploying the app to the custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in via ic-domains.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styling with custom OKLCH color tokens and dark mode variables.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the root React app and linking the PWA manifest.
frontend/PLAY_STORE_TWA_PUBLISHING_GUIDE: Detailed instructions for publishing the web app as an Android TWA using Bubblewrap and Play Console.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Digital Asset Links template file for Android TWA verification requiring package name and SHA-256 fingerprint.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Lists the single custom domain used for IC hosting.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and production start URL.
frontend/README.md: Frontend documentation covering features, deployment, quiz levels, question formats, and TWA publishing guide reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing authentication, quiz level selection, state transitions, and navigation across screens.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicC: Popover UI component providing mute toggle and volume slider for background music control.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmModal.tsx: A reusable confirmation dialog using AlertDialog components with customizable text and callbacks.
Displays a styled footnote section with an optional title and body content.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout with header, authentication controls, music controls, and quiz level tabs.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Shows current quiz progress as a percentage with a progress bar and label.
frontend/src/components/QuizLevelTabs.ts: Renders buttons for selecting quiz class levels with support for disabling changes.
frontend/src/components/ReadingPanel.tsx: Wraps main reading content with an optional footnote section in a structured layout.
frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js: Provides Class 10 science quiz questions including units, choices, and correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js: Class 7 science quiz question bank organized by units with options and correct answers.
frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js: Exports an array of Class 8 science quiz questions with units, options, and correct answers.
frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js: Exports an array of Class 9 quiz questions covering measurement and motion with answers included.
frontend/src/data/questions.js: Contains the full list of Class 6 science quiz questions with units, options, and answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor using react-query, updating it when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Custom hook that loads, plays, pauses, and controls volume and mute state for looping background audio.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status states.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for a gamified pastel theme with light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, rendering the root component.
frontend/src/quiz/committedCounts.ts: Computes counts of correct and wrong quiz answers based on committed selections, treating null as wrong.
frontend/src/quiz/loadQuestions.ts: Loads and validates quiz questions by class level, handling missing files and formatting errors.
frontend/src/quiz/scoring.ts: Computes total questions, correct answers, and score percentage from quiz state.
frontend/src/quiz/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for questions, answers, quiz state, and results.
frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts: Validates and normalizes question data, ensuring structure, options, and correct answer indices or text match.
frontend/src/screens/AuthenticationHelpS: UI screen explaining Internet Identity authentication with styled cards and help details.
frontend/src/screens/LoginRequiredScreen: Displays login prompt using Internet Identity with error handling and link to authentication help.
frontend/src/screens/QuestionScreen.tsx: Renders an interactive quiz question with timer, option selection, auto-submit, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows quiz results, percentage score, performance messaging, and options to restart or review answers.
frontend/src/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx: Displays a detailed review of all quiz questions, showing user answers, correctness status, and navigation options to return or restart.
frontend/src/screens/StartScreen.tsx: Renders the quiz start interface with hero graphics, quiz info, shuffle toggle, background music, and a start action.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, sizes, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, and new feature requests related to Play Store publishing and Firebase authentication.
